Module.Name: iris-relay
Module.Description: IRIS side of IRIS Relay: REST endpoints under /api/relay with a bounded Embedded Python reader for current and archived messages.log files (idea DPI-I-966) and similarity search across them with IRIS Vector Search. After install, IRIS serves Relay Lite at /relay/index.html (log viewer and lexical similarity search, no Node.js or Python server). The full Relay web UI runs with docker compose or Node; see the README.

WebApplication.Description: IRIS Relay Lite: static files only (CSP/ZEN off); its data comes from /api/relay with password authentication
IRIS Relay log reader and similarity search (requires %Admin_Operate:U)
